notes: Horne is at the left edge: only its east face is drawn here (x~423 north of 7th); centre x~340 taken from the 50/60 ft width labels and from sheet 34. West 8th: south block face y~392 west of the railroad (110 ft street, label 110'), y~290 east of it (60 ft per sheet 47); centreline computed at y~198-205, the double-dashed line is not the centreline. McLean Avenue is NOT labelled on this sheet; name from sheet 47 and the key map. Its centre (x~2085) is transferred from sheet 47 (100 ft wide, Horne-to-McLean spacing 1745 px); on this sheet the Cincinnati Southern tracks run down its west half and only the east half (white strip x~2005-2241 with a 6in water pipe) is shown, so the McLean x is good to about 25 px, not 15. McLean does not continue south of 7th (Gale lumber yard). West 7th exists only east of McLean here; between Horne and McLean the Banning lumber yard covers the old street bed, so 7th meets Horne as a T from the west (drawn on sheet 34). Budd likewise is not open east of Horne on this sheet; it resumes east of the trestle at y~1762 (faces 1680/1845) and runs east onto sheet 36; Horne/Budd is not recorded here because Budd is not drawn at Horne on this sheet. Deming Alley runs east past the drawn area (x~3835) onto sheet 36; no width printed. West 6th runs along the bottom edge (north face y~4400-4410, centreline ~4500-4510 at the paper edge) with no cross streets on this sheet. The area east of x~3670 between 8th and 7th is left blank (covered by sheet 36). West 6th is labelled 66' here (60' on sheet 34).
